result:
DashboardController now has a test file recognized, and remaining warnings are pre-existing/unrelated. Everything passes.

I updated `DashboardController` (`app/Http/Controllers/DashboardController.ts`) to load the signed-in user's post count (`Post.where({ authorId }).count()`) and their 5 most recent posts (`orderBy('createdAt', 'desc').orderBy('id', 'desc').limit(5)`, with `id` as a tiebreaker since same-millisecond timestamps aren't otherwise stably ordered), passing `postCount` and `recentPosts: { id, title }[]` to the Inertia page. Updated `resources/js/pages/dashboard/Index.tsx` to render "You have N post(s)", a "Recent posts" list linking to `/posts/<id>`, and an empty-state message with a link to `/posts/create` when there are no posts. Regenerated codegen manifests and added `tests/DashboardController.test.ts` covering the guest redirect, the zero-post empty state, and that only the signed-in user's 5 newest posts appear in the right order. `bun run typecheck`, `bun test`, and `bunx guren check` all pass.
